official: 羽村市会計年度任用職員の報酬等に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 審理員職に弁護士資格者を任用
summary: 行政不服審査法第9条に規定する審理員職に、弁護士資格を持つ人を会計年度任用職員として任用するため、条例を改正します。施行日は令和8年4月1日です。
changes: 審理員職に弁護士資格を持つ人を会計年度任用職員として任用する
why: 審理員職に弁護士資格を持つ人を会計年度任用職員として任用するためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Appoints a lawyer as a review officer
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Hamura City Ordinance on Remuneration, etc. for Fiscal Year-Appointed Employees
en.summary: The city will amend the ordinance to appoint a person qualified as a lawyer as a fiscal year-appointed employee in the position of review officer provided for in Article 9 of the Administrative Complaint Review Act. The ordinance will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Appoints a person qualified as a lawyer as a fiscal year-appointed employee in the position of review officer
en.why: The city says this is to appoint a person qualified as a lawyer as a fiscal year-appointed employee in the position of review officer.
